statement: Texts that contain closer G407 or G617 are copper objects (in practice, the copper tablets of Mohenjo-daro) more often than chance. Exploration: 12 of 67 such texts are copper (17.9%) against 3.1% of all texts; ending in G407/G617: 9 of 43 (20.9%). 'Contains' is the registered statistic because 'ends in' would very likely fall below the minimum support of 15 in the holdout; the 'ends in' rate will be reported as a descriptive figure, not tested. Source: results/closer_categories_ext.md.
